reviewed: module.json (patched; walked S2 to S7 node text in full, S1 partly)
patched_segments_check: S4, S6, S7 patches verified in module.json: S4.not_list_intro now precedes the NOT question on both paths; S6.peer_t10 gives the 1 L figure and a Show-me exit; S6.peer_t27 gives the TXA window reason; S6.brain_t18 has Show-me; S7 wrong nodes all have a retry or a Show-me exit. Earlier round-0 flaws on these points are resolved.

segments.reason: Probe first, sure-noted refutation naming the loudest-problem model, time-to-death rule taught before the repeat, skip lane at S1.gate_ok and S1.talk_ok. Unpatched; sim walk clean.
Three-peak probes where each wrong option is a named trap (TR30, TR1) with a why-node separating peaks by timing; order probe has sure_note and a skip lane; S2.close recaps cleanly. Unpatched.
Vignettes carry TR2 and TR22 with GCS and age as qualifiers, each wrong option a single trap; teach nodes follow every miss. Partial options (S3.p2_p, S3.p3_p, S3.p4_p) exit to Try again only.

Patched: contrast probes separate each look-alike and every trap option maps to one trap; not_list now lists the five before the NOT question; explanation nodes mostly offer Got-it forward moves. Some keys are findable by form and some explain nodes still loop back to Try again.
Worked case then fade ladder with mechanism-first explanations (S5.why_show, S5.fade1_show, S5.fade4_show) and a skip lane; each fade option maps to one trap. Unpatched and clean in the sim.

Patched wrong nodes now carry the fix, but most probes are two real choices plus a hint (S6.txa, S6.child_air, S6.site_pair, S6.flail, S6.cath2) with the key findable by form; every S6 explain node (peer_exp10, cath_exp, site_exp and others) exits only to Try again, a forced retest with no forward move; the generic 'That choice is not right.' opener reads as contradictory when the option was the correct step (S6.peer_t10, S6.peer_t27).

Cold transfer quiz of eleven stems with four-, three- and two-option probes and a skip lane, but the keys are findable by form (S7.p7 key is the shortest option; S7.p8, S7.p9 and S7.p10 keys are the longest; S7.p4 key is the only option that splits by patient). Stems re-ask beliefs already corrected in S1 to S6 and are not interleaved. S7.open says 'Show me why' while the wrong-node label reads 'Show me what is right'.

best_parts: node S5.why and S5.fade1 family (S5.fade1_t9a, S5.fade1_show): worked case, then a faded probe where each wrong option is its own TR9 or TR17 model, with a mechanism-first explanation that names the pulse before the pressure.
node S4.ppv_t5 with S4.ppv_why: predict-then-show for the one-way valve; the trap is named, the mechanism is traced, and a Got-it forward move follows.
node S2.order_t1a with its sure_note: a confident error is named in the learner's own terms (a large threat can still be a slow one) before the time-to-death rule is repeated.
node S6.peer_t10 with its exp node S6.peer_exp10: the corrected dose and the reason for the change (dilution, cooling) are both given, so a 2 L believer leaves with a usable figure.
node S4.site_adult_t11a with S4.site_child_t11: both exam keys are set side by side and the age split is named as the rule to keep.
flaws: nodes S6.peer_exp10, S6.peer_exp27, S6.cath_exp, S6.cath2_exp, S6.child_exp, S6.site_exp, S6.site_exp3, S6.pair_exp, S6.flail_exp, S6.brain_exp, S6.txa_exp, S6.fluid_exp, S6.ssurvey_exp: each explanation offers only Try again, which forces a retest of the same stem with no forward move. Add a Next that leads to the next probe (R5).

nodes S6.peer_t10 and S6.peer_t27: the opener 'That choice is not right.' is followed by 'Step 1 is correct' or 'Step 3 is correct as written'. On a correct step this reads as a contradiction to a tired learner. Reword the opener to name the choice, for example 'Flagging step 1 as the error is the mistake' (R4, R8).

nodes S6.txa, S6.child_air, S6.site_pair, S6.flail, S6.cath2: two real choices plus a hint, so a guess is a coin flip and the key is findable by its longer, qualified wording. Add a third distractor for the same trap family or a partial option (R2).

nodes S7.p7, S7.p8, S7.p9, S7.p10: the key is the shortest option in p7 and the longest in p8, p9 and p10, so the answer is findable by form. Pad or trim wording so the key is not the odd length (R2).
node S7.p4: the only option that splits the airway by patient is the key; the two 'for both' options are the traps, so the structure gives the answer away (R2).
node S7.open: its text says 'A wrong pick gets a retry or a Show me why', but every wrong node in S7 is labelled 'Show me what is right'. Make the label and the text match (R8).

segment S7 as a whole: eleven cold stems in a row with no interleaved teaching, and most re-ask a belief already corrected earlier (S7.p2 repeats the S4.ppv valve, S7.p5 repeats the S1.talk airway, S7.p11 repeats the S4.tamp tamponade). It reads as repetition more than transfer (R2, R4, R8).
node S6.case: says the plan has five steps, but the peer probe uses a four-step plan and S6.wx gives steps 1 to 5 over two screens. Align the count (R4).

report.json (trap and objective texts): trap states are template wording and are assigned by first encounter only. In sim/misconceived.report.json TR27 is reported 'avoided' although the sim fell into it at the S6.peer retry (R9).

sim/misconceived.report.json headline 'mixed' and objective tiers (19 of 20 objectives shaky, O9 secure) ignore the 9 of 9 cold-quiz result and the full recovery of all 19 traps. The headline and tiers should use the cold-quiz results and name the qualifier to fix first (R9).

sim/misconceived.report.json 'hints': 17 counts 'Show me why' taps as hints, and the help text says 'asked for hints or explanations often'. The sim never tapped a hint option, so the report misstates help use. Count hint taps and explanation taps separately (R9).

report_check.headline: The mixed headline does not match the misconceived walk: all traps were refuted at least once, 9 of 9 cold stems were correct, and the only retry-only falls (TR18, TR27) are unreported. It should say which qualifier to fix first and mention the cold quiz.
report_check.objectives: Objective tiers are template wording that does not use the cold quiz; O1, O2 and O5 read shaky although the cold stems p1, p5 and p8 were right. Use cold-quiz results to set secure versus shaky.
report_check.traps: Traps report first encounter only. TR27 is 'avoided' though the sim fell at the retry; TR18 is 'fell_recovered' with a weak correction. Report the retry-only falls distinctly.
report_check.calibration: overconfident, sure_wrong 19: accurate. guess_right 0 is accurate for this walk.
report_check.help: hints 17 counts explanation taps as hints. Separate hint taps from Show-me taps.
report_check.next_steps: Ordering is useful: confident errors first, then gaps, then shaky, with one concrete action. Add a cold-quiz line when the cold quiz was passed.

personas_checked.misconceived: rendered report present; judged above. Path separates each wrong model at the point of choice; report names the model back for each trap, which is the strongest part. Headline, tiers and help count misstate this learner.
personas_checked.novice: no sim/novice.report.json exists in the workshop, not judged.
personas_checked.guesser: no sim/guesser.report.json exists in the workshop, not judged.
personas_checked.strong: no sim/strong.report.json exists in the workshop, not judged.

sim_check.misconceived: The path separates each wrong model at the point of choice for S1 to S5 and the patched S4 and S6 nodes correct the belief on the first miss. The sim's own verdict was engagement 3 of 5. The S6 explain nodes with only Try again and the S7 repetition are the weakest stretch.
sim_check.fixes_needed: Add a forward move to every S6 explain node. Reword the S6.peer correct-step openers. Pad S7 keys to equal length and interleave a teach node. Fix the report headline, tiers and help count.

merge_ideas: Apply the S5 worked-case-then-fade structure to S6: a worked plan first, then one faded probe per step, each wrong option a single trap, and an explanation with a Next forward move.
Interleave S7: alternate a fresh stem with a one-screen teach or a skip-if-correct lane, and give each cold stem a different surface form so the key is not findable by length.
Use the S4.ppv predict-then-show pattern for the S6.fluid and S6.txa probes, so the number is tied to its mechanism before the retest.
Make the report tiers depend on the cold quiz: refuted then recovered on the cold quiz is secure, refuted then fell again is shaky, and name the first qualifier to fix in the headline.
unscored_notes: Not gated. No typing and no run-time model.
